headline: Pinglu Canal: From a Shorter Route to Closer Ties Between China and ASEAN - Chen Ziqi
summary: A commentary says the Pinglu Canal in southern China will reduce logistics costs, strengthen regional supply chains and boost integration with Southeast Asian countries.
why: Large waterway and logistics projects change shipping costs and trade routes, which matters for exporters, ports and freight operators in the region.
